discovered_modules.name: atproto
discovered_modules.description: Thin protocol-aware overlay analyzer for AT Protocol namespace and XRPC exposure.
discovered_modules.scope: AT Protocol repositories with lexicons, XRPC namespace usage, and protocol auth/identity cues.

discovered_modules.name: c
discovered_modules.description: C ecosystem analyzer covering libmicrohttpd, civetweb, mongoose, libonion, libcurl, OpenSSL, libsodium, sqlite3, libpq, mysql, hiredis, mongoc.
discovered_modules.scope: C source trees and CMake/Make projects. Detects HTTP server entrypoints, libcurl outbound calls, common DB and crypto libraries.

discovered_modules.name: config
discovered_modules.description: Broad built-in analyzer for YAML / TOML / JSON / INI / .env application config files.
discovered_modules.scope: Application config files. Extracts DB connection strings, external service URLs, and secret-shaped literals; deep IaC parsing (docker-compose service graph, Dockerfile hardening) lives in attackmap-analyzer-iac.

discovered_modules.name: cpp
discovered_modules.description: C++ analyzer covering Crow, Pistache, Drogon, cpprestsdk, libcurl/cpr, OpenSSL/Botan/libsodium/Crypto++, libpqxx/mongocxx/redis-plus-plus.
discovered_modules.scope: C++ source trees and CMake projects. Detects modern HTTP frameworks and common DB / crypto libraries.

discovered_modules.name: default
discovered_modules.description: Fallback built-in analyzer for code file suffixes not claimed by a specialized built-in.
discovered_modules.scope: Any CODE_EXTENSIONS suffix not covered by python-web or javascript-web.

discovered_modules.name: dotnet
discovered_modules.description: ASP.NET Core analyzer covering minimal APIs, attribute routing, EF Core, Identity, and JwtBearer.
discovered_modules.scope: .NET solutions and projects (.csproj, .sln). Detects ASP.NET Core minimal APIs and controllers.

discovered_modules.name: go
discovered_modules.description: Go ecosystem analyzer covering net/http, chi, gin, echo, fiber, gorilla/mux, and common DB/auth packages.
discovered_modules.scope: Go modules and workspaces. go.mod-bearing repos are auto-detected; pure .go trees also work.

discovered_modules.name: iac
discovered_modules.description: Analyzer for infrastructure-as-code and deployment files: Dockerfile, docker-compose, GitHub Actions, .env templates, shell installers.
discovered_modules.scope: Deployment / operations repositories where the runtime posture is defined outside application source. Closes the coverage gap Bluesky FINDINGS §2 documented for bluesky-social/pds.

discovered_modules.name: java-spring
discovered_modules.description: Java and Kotlin analyzer with Spring Boot, JAX-RS, Ktor, and Spring Security awareness.
discovered_modules.scope: Maven, Gradle, and Kotlin Spring Boot projects. Detects Spring MVC, JAX-RS, Ktor, Javalin, and Micronaut routing.

discovered_modules.name: javascript-web
discovered_modules.description: Broad built-in analyzer for JavaScript and TypeScript web applications.
discovered_modules.scope: JavaScript/TypeScript source files (.js/.jsx/.mjs/.cjs/.ts/.tsx). Deep framework coverage lives in attackmap-analyzer-node-service; this is the fallback.

discovered_modules.name: node-atproto
discovered_modules.description: Thin ATProto / Node-service overlay: XRPC lexicon surface, identity and signing hotspots, service boundaries, and cross-file route wiring.
discovered_modules.scope: Repositories that look like ATProto services (lexicons, @atproto dependencies, did:/NSID markers). Enriches javascript-web; extraction only, never scores.

discovered_modules.name: node-service
discovered_modules.description: Broad Node.js/TypeScript service analyzer covering Express/Fastify/NestJS/Hono/Koa/Elysia/tRPC + NextJS routes, XRPC handlers, workspaces, async workers.
discovered_modules.scope: Node/TypeScript backend and monorepo repositories with service boundaries, framework handlers, RPC handlers, and inter-service/async messaging.

discovered_modules.name: omeka-s
discovered_modules.description: Application overlay for Omeka S modules: module layout, API adapters vs representations vs routes, admin authentication, media ingestion, view output encoding.
discovered_modules.scope: Repos with an Omeka S module marker (Omeka\Module\AbstractModule) or an omeka/* composer dependency.

discovered_modules.name: php-laminas
discovered_modules.description: Framework enrichment for Laminas / Zend MVC: module structure, router config, controllers/actions, service-manager wiring, middleware, validators/filters.
discovered_modules.scope: Repos with laminas/ or zendframework/ composer dependencies, or Module.php files carrying Laminas/Zend markers.

discovered_modules.name: php-web
discovered_modules.description: Built-in analyzer for plain PHP web applications: generic routes plus request input, include chains, session/cookie handling, datastores, outbound HTTP.
discovered_modules.scope: PHP source files (.php). Framework structure lives in php-laminas; Omeka S specifics in omeka-s.

discovered_modules.name: python
discovered_modules.description: Comprehensive Python analyzer for Django, Starlette, AIOHTTP, Sanic, Litestar, DRF; SQLAlchemy/asyncpg/motor; passlib/PyJWT/authlib; httpx/aiohttp.
discovered_modules.scope: Python projects (pyproject.toml, setup.py, manage.py, or any *.py tree). Additive over the built-in python-web analyzer.

discovered_modules.name: python-service
discovered_modules.description: Framework-enrichment overlay for Python web services (FastAPI/Flask/Django/Celery cross-file wiring).
discovered_modules.scope: Python web-service repositories; adds cross-file router/blueprint/URLconf wiring, framework auth semantics, ORM scoping, and service-boundary signals on top of the per-file python-web pass.

discovered_modules.name: python-web
discovered_modules.description: Built-in analyzer for Python web frameworks and related security signals.
discovered_modules.scope: Python source files handled by the current scanner-backed web heuristics.

discovered_modules.name: rust
discovered_modules.description: Rust ecosystem analyzer covering axum, actix-web, rocket, common DB/auth crates, and reqwest.
discovered_modules.scope: Rust crates and workspaces. Cargo-bearing repos are auto-detected; pure .rs trees also work.

discovered_modules.name: swift
discovered_modules.description: Swift ecosystem analyzer: SwiftPM project detection and Package.resolved dependency SBOM. Server-side routes and app attack surface land in later slices.
discovered_modules.scope: Swift source trees and SwiftPM/Xcode projects. Detects the SwiftPM toolchain, server-side web frameworks in the manifest, and resolved package dependencies for CVE/SBOM.

discovered_modules.name: terraform
discovered_modules.description: Terraform infrastructure-as-code analyzer covering AWS, Azure, and GCP resources, IAM wildcards, open security groups, and secrets.
discovered_modules.scope: Terraform / OpenTofu projects (.tf files). Detects provider-level resources, public ingress, secret resources, and database engines.
